title.value: Enquire One’s Parent and Child Before Decision: Fully Exploit Hierarchical Structure for Self-Supervised Taxonomy Expansion
title.justification: The title is found at the beginning of the paper, which states the main idea of utilizing hierarchical structures for self-supervised taxonomy expansion.
title.quote: Enquire One’s Parent and Child Before Decision: Fully Exploit Hierarchical Structure for Self-Supervised Taxonomy Expansion

analysis.description: This paper introduces the Hierarchy Expansion Framework (HEF) for taxonomy expansion by leveraging hierarchical structures and self-supervised learning. HEF uniquely utilizes subtrees for comparison of relations, models taxonomy coherence, and introduces the Fitting Score for evaluating the expanded taxonomy. Empirical results show substantial improvements over previous methods using benchmark datasets.

type.justification: The paper conducts extensive experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model, Hierarchy Expansion Framework (HEF), on three benchmark datasets.
type.quote: Extensive experiments show that by better exploiting the hierarchical structure and optimizing taxonomy’s coherence, HEF vastly surpasses the prior state-of-the-art on three benchmark datasets by an average improvement of 46.7% in accuracy and 32.3% in mean reciprocal rank.

name.justification: The research focuses on taxonomy expansion, a task related to understanding and processing linguistic data structures, which falls under the domain of Natural Language Processing (NLP).
name.quote: Taxonomy is a hierarchically structured knowledge graph that plays a crucial role in machine intelligence.

name.justification: The paper's methods relate to self-supervised learning, a subfield of Machine Learning, to train models for taxonomy expansion.
name.quote: Formerly, taxonomy expansion solutions do not fully utilize the taxonomy’s hierarchical structure’s characteristics, and HEF aims to address these limitations using Machine Learning techniques.

name.justification: HEF is proposed in this paper as a novel model for taxonomy expansion.
name.quote: In this paper, we propose the Hierarchy Expansion Framework (HEF), which fully exploits the hierarchical structure’s properties to maximize the coherence of expanded taxonomy.
